If AI systems derive value from news, the organizations that invest in reporting, fact-finding, and accountability journalism must have leverage in determining the terms of that relationship. The UK CMA’s binding conduct requirement on Google is a first step toward that, writes Courtney C. Radsch.

AI forces a “paranoid reading” style on people who don’t want to be paranoid readers and on non-using writers who just want to be taken on their own (human) terms. 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/ai-imposes...
"Artificial intelligence is an anti-community technology whose principal civic innovation is to reduce social trust and engender a greater sense of unreality in our lives."

This whole story illustrates my thesis that LLMs are not a democratizing technology; they are an anti-egalitarian technology.

As inboxes fill with these kind of scams, authors are forced to ignore cold emails and genuine good faith messages from the community get ignored.

Strong feeling that uni lecturers are the canary in this particular coal mine. The best thing* about marking work is getting enthusiastic about students' enthusiasm. But we can't do that anymore; we have to constantly suspicious. It stinks.
